description: The overall average option volume ratio is the average of the transaction-reference and trader-type combination averages.

b.request: Join each sentiment snapshot to its transaction record and that record's trader (inner joins only), average optvolrt per (transref, tradekind) pair, take the overall average as the mean of those pair averages, compute each pair's deviation from it (null if the overall is missing), then within each tradekind (excluding null tradekind) keep only pairs whose deviation exceeds that type's average deviation, with excess = deviation minus that average, and report per tradekind the average optvolrt, average deviation and average excess of the kept pairs, ignoring nulls and not rounding
b.sql: WITH pairs AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, tr.tradekind AS tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS pair_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS overall_avg FROM pairs), dev AS (SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, CASE WHEN o.overall_avg IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ABS(p.pair_avg - o.overall_avg) END AS deviation FROM pairs p CROSS JOIN overall o), kind_avg AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS avg_dev FROM dev WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tradekind), kept AS (SELECT d.tradekind, d.pair_avg, d.deviation, d.deviation - k.avg_dev AS excess FROM dev d JOIN kind_avg k ON d.tradekind = k.tradekind WHERE d.deviation > k.avg_dev) SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_avg) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind

a.request: Link each sentiment snapshot to its transaction record (`transref` = `transreg`) and to that record's trader (`trdref` = `tradereg`), dropping snapshots without both matches. For each combination of transaction reference (`transref`) and trader type (`tradekind`), compute the average option volume ratio (`optvolrt`). Take as the baseline the plain average of these per-combination averages, with each combination counting equally. Each combination's deviation is its average minus the baseline (no rows if the baseline is missing). Within each trader type, average those deviations. Keep only the combinations whose deviation is above their trader type's average deviation, and give each one an excess: its deviation minus the type's average deviation. Combinations with no trader type get a deviation too but are dropped at this comparison. Finally, for each trader type, report the type, the average of the kept combinations' average option volume ratios, the average of their deviations, and the average of their excess. Averages ignore missing values. No rounding.
a.sql: WITH combo AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, tr.tradekind AS tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_opt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind), base AS (SELECT AVG(avg_opt) AS baseline FROM combo), dev AS (SELECT c.transref, c.tradekind, c.avg_opt, c.avg_opt - b.baseline AS deviation FROM combo c CROSS JOIN base b WHERE b.baseline IS NOT NULL), typeavg AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS type_avg_dev FROM dev WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tradekind), kept AS (SELECT d.tradekind, d.avg_opt, d.deviation, d.deviation - ta.type_avg_dev AS excess FROM dev d JOIN typeavg ta ON d.tradekind = ta.tradekind WHERE d.deviation > ta.type_avg_dev) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_opt) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind

c.request: Link each sentiment snapshot to its transaction record (`transref` = `transreg`) and that record's trader (`trdref` = `tradereg`), keeping only full matches, and compute the average option volume ratio (`optvolrt`) for each transaction reference and trader type (`tradekind`) pair. Measure each pair's deviation from the overall average option volume ratio (no rows if that's missing). Then, within each trader type, keep only the pairs whose deviation beats the type's average deviation, and note by how much (pairs with no trader type drop out at this step). For each trader type, what are the average option volume ratio, the average deviation and the average excess of those pairs? Averages ignore missing values. Don't round. The overall average option volume ratio is the average of the transaction-reference and trader-type combination averages.
c.sql: WITH pairs AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, tr.tradekind AS tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_ovr FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ovr) AS overall_avg FROM pairs), dev AS (SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.avg_ovr, ABS(p.avg_ovr - o.overall_avg) AS deviation FROM pairs p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), typed AS (SELECT d.*, AVG(d.deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY d.tradekind) AS type_avg_dev FROM dev d WHERE d.tradekind IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT tradekind, avg_ovr, deviation, deviation - type_avg_dev AS excess FROM typed WHERE deviation > type_avg_dev) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_ovr) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind

d.request: Link each sentiment snapshot to its transaction record (`transref` = `transreg`) and that record's trader (`trdref` = `tradereg`), keeping only full matches. Compute the average option volume ratio (`optvolrt`) for each transaction reference and trader type (`tradekind`) pair. Define the overall average option volume ratio as the average of these pair averages, not the average across all individual rows. Measure each pair's deviation from this overall average (no rows if it's missing). Then, within each trader type, keep only the pairs whose deviation beats the type's average deviation, and note by how much (pairs with no trader type drop out at this step). For each trader type, what are the average option volume ratio, the average deviation, and the average excess of those pairs? Averages ignore missing values. Don't round.
d.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg), p AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS pair_avg FROM j GROUP BY transref, tradekind), o AS (SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS overall FROM p), d AS (SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, ABS(p.pair_avg - o.overall) AS dev FROM p CROSS JOIN o WHERE p.pair_avg IS NOT NULL AND o.overall IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT d.*, AVG(dev) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_dev FROM d WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL) SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_avg) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(dev) AS avg_deviation, AVG(dev - type_avg_dev) AS avg_excess FROM k WHERE dev > type_avg_dev GROUP BY tradekind
